items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Smack knew me from years before, you know. I mean, I wasn't no stranger to him... So okay, I was just hired on the moment

ctx.x: Well, that's when he was arranging for his first band. That goes way back. And the band that he had after Louis went back to Chicago, Smack was doing his own writing then. That's when he had the tough arrangements.
